issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory 检查所有父路径但不检查 path.parent 是否为文件，当 path 本身是目录时可能产生误导性错误
approach: Add explicit parent check before the ancestor loop with clearer error message
changes_summary: Added explicit check for path.parent being a file in _ensure_parent_directory() with clearer error message, modified ancestor loop to skip parent since it's now checked separately

ruff_check.command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_issue_5389_parent_check.py

acceptance_criteria_met: When parent exists and is a file, raises ValueError with clear 'not a directory' message
When parent doesn't exist, successfully creates directory
When parent is a directory, continues normally
risks_limitations: Minimal risk - the change makes the error handling more explicit but doesn't change the logical behavior
